{"consolidated_memory":"MOBILE/IOS/SYNCENGINE.SWIFT: TWO SEPARATE CONFLICT LOOP INCIDENTS

Component: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)
Symptom (both incidents): Conflict loop - two clients rewriting each other on every pass
Test coverage: mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift
Repro (both): Edit the same note on two devices offline

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-04]
---
Trigger: Only occurred for clients pinned to the v1 SDK
Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR #1448, branch fix/conflict-loop-1
Result: Backlog cleared 5 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-13]
---
Trigger: Only occurred for payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: Two writes were never wrapped in a transaction
Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
PR #3327, branch fix/conflict-loop-2
Result: Throughput rose 39 percent, to 970 requests per second"}
